title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover thrashing
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Fixes a race in the SLO enforcer backoff logic that caused repeated regional failover/restore cycles under bursty traffic. Improves stability and reduces unnecessary failovers.
description: Context: After a production incident on 2026-02-17 (SUP-2148 / ENG-4821) we observed the SLO enforcer entering a backoff/failover thrash: when one region degraded briefly, the enforcer repeatedly tripped circuit-breakers and triggered regional failover, then immediately restored, causing oscillation and additional load. Root cause: a combination of a suboptimal backoff timer reset (race when concurrent health updates arrived) and aggressive immediate restore policy. This PR contains a targeted hotfix: 1) make backoff timer updates idempotent and single-writer per-enforcer instance; 2) add minimum-stabilization window before automatic regional-restore to avoid oscillation; 3) telemetry to detect future thrashing patterns. Changes are deliberately small and behind a feature flag (slo_enforcer.stabilize_backoff) to allow canary rollout. Regression tests and an e2e chaos test added. Checklist: - [x] Repro locally with stress harness - [x] Unit tests for backoff logic - [x] e2e chaos test (regional fail + heal) - [x] Telemetry metrics added (slo_enforcer.thrash_count, slo_enforcer.backoff_updates) - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan - [x] Docs: brief note in SLO enforcer readme Reproduction: steps in incident doc (linked) show 10s regional latency spike + concurrent health updates triggers thrash. Fix summary: - Use CAS (compare-and-swap) semantics for in-memory backoff state updates to avoid lost/overwrites from concurrent goroutines. - Add configurable stabilize_window (default 30s) before auto-restore is allowed; immediate restores still possible via manual operator action. - Emit thrash_count when failover/restore happens within 60s window. Testing: - Unit tests added to enforcer/backoff_test.go covering races. - Small perf smoke to ensure backoff updates stay O(1). Observability: - New metrics, logs include backoff_state transitions. - Alert tweak suggested: reduce noisy pager by thresholding thrash_count > 3 in 10m. Deployment plan: - Merge to main, enable feature flag off by default. - Canary on dedicated region us-west-2 for 24h, monitor thrash_count and failover rates. - Gradual rollout to remaining regions. Related: incident postmortem linked in ENG-4821.
